messages.author: 04f5532fdcc05e23
messages.subject: Query about second order factor iamos
parts: I am doing research on HRM practices and employee's knowledge sharing behavior: mediation on affective commitment and affect-based trust. I was conducted six factor CFA in Amos software to test the fitness of measurement model and confirm convergent and discriminant validity, which was confirmed. But i want to combine all HRM practices (recruitment & selection, training & development, compensation & rewards) into one construct and then again perform overall second order measurement model. While performing overall second order measurement model i also have no validity and model fitness issue, but when i performed second order construct of HRM practices then there is an issue of model fit indices (RMSEA). Thus move towards the modification indices to see the variance among error terms to overcome this issue. Can i covariate the errors of one sub-construct with other sub-construct. e.g. error of recruitment & selection with error of training & development to overcome this issue. If not, then what can i do to resolve this issue.
